enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Shield Bashing +11%: +11% Enhancement bonus to your chance of a Secondary Shield Bash. This stacks with bonuses granted by any relevant feats.
Insightful Incite +27: +27% Insight bonus to increased threat generation from melee damage
Profane Lifeforce +23: +23 Profane bonus to Hit Points.
Legendary Conditioning +15%: You have a +15% Legendary bonus to Maximum Hit Points.
